MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_OCHAINS_CRY.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {BlockPerEnemy} [gold]Block[/gold] for each enemy hit.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_EXILES_GRUDGE.d:
Apply {Vuln} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to the target and up to 2 other random enemies.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (2 Vulnerable from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_LONE_HILL.title: Lone Hill
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_LONE_HILL.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this hit only one enemy, attack it once more.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_FERGUS_WRATH.de:
This combat, whenever one of your attacks hits 2 or more enemies, deal {WrathDamage} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
